home.heroTitle: Pick a seat, pick a time, pay in three steps
home.heroSubtitle: Search the film you want and choose your seat right away — sign-up comes later.

movie.comingSoonNotice: Tickets for this film are not on sale yet

seats.title: Select seats
seats.holdNotice: Your seats will be held for {{minutes}} minutes to complete payment
seats.seatTaken: Seat {{seats}} was just taken. Please choose again.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the email or phone number you registered with

register.title: Create an account
register.subtitle: Sign up once, book any showtime
register.emailHint: This is your username when signing in
register.emailInvalid: That email address doesn't look right
register.phoneHint: We use it to reach you about bookings — and you can sign in with it too
register.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid 10-digit Thai mobile number
register.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers
register.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
register.passwordNeedsLetter: Password must contain at least one letter
register.passwordNeedsNumber: Password must contain at least one number

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter the email you signed up with and we will send you a reset link
forgot.emailHint: Must be the same email you used to sign up
forgot.sentSubtitle: The next step is in your inbox
forgot.sentBody: If {{email}} has an account with us, we have sent it a link to set a new password. The link works for {{minutes}} minutes and can only be used once.
forgot.sentHint: Nothing in your inbox? Check the spam folder too.
forgot.devNotice: Development mode — no mail server configured yet, use this link instead

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.signedOutNotice: Setting a new password signs this account out on every device
reset.success: Password updated — please sign in with your new password
reset.missingToken: The link is incomplete. Open it from your email again, or request a new one.

profile.title: My profile
profile.subtitle: Change your display name and account password
profile.contactLocked: To change your email or phone number, please contact an administrator
profile.passwordNotice: Changing your password signs you out on every other device
profile.sameAsCurrent: The new password must differ from the current one

payment.title: Payment
payment.scanHint: Open your banking app and scan the QR code below
payment.uploadHint: Upload the transfer slip (JPG / PNG / WEBP, max 5MB)
payment.waitingBody: We received your slip. Your seats stay reserved until the review is done — no need to pay again.
payment.waitingHint: This page updates itself when the result is in.
payment.rejectedRetry: Please transfer again and upload a new slip before the timer runs out.
payment.verifyNotice: This QR follows the PromptPay standard — scan it with any banking app. After transferring, upload your slip so an admin can verify the payment.

ticket.title: E-Ticket
ticket.scanAtEntrance: Show this QR at the entrance

bookings.title: My bookings
bookings.cancelBody: Cancel booking {{code}}? The seats will be released immediately.
bookings.cancelPolicy: Free cancellation up to {{hours}} hours before showtime
bookings.cancelBlocked: Too late to cancel (must be at least {{hours}} hours before showtime)
bookings.cancelAwaitingReview: Your slip is being reviewed — you can cancel once the result is in
bookings.refundAccountIntro: This booking is already paid. An admin will transfer the refund manually — please tell us where to send it.
bookings.refundAccountLater: We will transfer the refund for booking {{code}} to this account. Please double-check the account number before saving.

movieForm.archiveExplain: Hides it from customers but keeps all booking history (recommended)
movieForm.forceDeleteExplain: Erases its showtimes, bookings and payments for good — cannot be undone

theatreForm.name: Theatre name
theatreForm.seatEditorHint: Click seats to select, then change the zone or disable them
theatreForm.resizeWarning: Changing the grid size regenerates every seat
theatreForm.deleteShowtimesNote: Its {{count}} showtime(s) will be deleted too.
theatreForm.isActiveHint: Turn off while under repair or retired — theatres with booking history can't be deleted, deactivate them instead

showtimeForm.priceHint: Premium and sofa prices are derived automatically
showtimeForm.noBusy: No showtimes here yet — any time works
showtimeForm.freeSlots: Available start times ({{minutes}} min gap between shows)
showtimeForm.noFreeSlot: No room left for this film today. Try another date or theatre.
showtimeForm.cancelEffects: Every booking for this showtime will be cancelled and its seats released, paid bookings go to the refund queue, and every customer is notified. This cannot be undone.
showtimeForm.cancelledToast: Showtime cancelled — {{count}} bookings closed, {{refunds}} refunds queued

paymentQueue.approveConfirm: Confirm the full amount was received?

reportsPage.refundBody: {{count}} bookings totalling {{amount}} THB ({{pending}} still unpaid, {{pendingAmount}} THB) — already deducted from the revenue above

refundPage.manualNotice: This system never charges the card itself, so it cannot refund automatically — transfer the money back in your banking app first, then record it here.
refundPage.editBody: Replace the slip or edit the note for the {{amount}} THB refund to {{name}}. It stays refunded and the customer isn't notified again.
refundPage.replaceSlip: Attach a new slip to replace the current one (optional)
refundPage.confirmBody: Confirm that {{amount}} THB was transferred back to {{name}}
refundPage.copyFailed: Couldn't copy — please copy it manually
refundPage.noAccount: No account given — call the customer

userPage.title: User management
userPage.subtitle: Find customer accounts, fix contact details, reset passwords, and grant admin access
userPage.selfRoleHint: You cannot change your own role — another administrator has to do it
userPage.selfPasswordHint: Change your own password from the profile page
userPage.resetBody: Set a temporary password for {{name}} and ask them to change it on their profile page. This signs the account out everywhere.
userPage.deleteBlocked: Accounts with booking history cannot be deleted — sales reports would lose those records

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.notFoundBody: The link may be wrong or the page has moved.
